exams.name: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination - Registered Nurse)
exams.notes: Board may use the state board test pool examination, its successor, or any other nationally standardized examination identified by the board in its rules.
exams.quote: The board may use any part or all of the state board test pool examination for registered nurse licensure, its successor examination, or any other nationally standardized examination identified by the board in its rules.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN (National Council Licensure Examination - Practical Nurse)
exams.notes: Board may use the state board test pool examination for practical nurse licensure, its successor, or any other nationally standardized examination identified by the board in its rules.
exams.quote: The board may use any part or all of the state board test pool examination for practical nurse licensure, its successor examination, or any other nationally standardized examination identified by the board in its rules.

exams.name: National Association of Long-Term Care Administrator Board (NAB) examination
exams.notes: Required for nursing home administrator licensure, along with the Mississippi State Board of Nursing Home Administrators examination.
exams.quote: Has successfully passed the National Association of Long-Term Care Administrator Board (NAB) examination and the Mississippi State Board of Nursing Home Administrators examination

exams.name: Mississippi State Board of Nursing Home Administrators examination
exams.notes: State examination required for nursing home administrator licensure in addition to the NAB examination.
exams.quote: Has successfully passed the National Association of Long-Term Care Administrator Board (NAB) examination and the Mississippi State Board of Nursing Home Administrators examination to test his or her proficiency and basic knowledge in the area of nursing home administration.

interval_years.quote: the license to practice as a registered nurse shall be valid for two (2) calendar years, beginning January 1 of each uneven-numbered year and expiring December 31 in each even-numbered year of the biennial period

required.quote: The board shall by rule prescribe continuing education requirements for advanced practice nurses not to exceed forty (40) hours biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education requirements for advanced practice nurses not to exceed forty (40) hours biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate

period_years.quote: continuing education requirements for advanced practice nurses not to exceed forty (40) hours biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state, territory or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or a foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must meet qualifications required of licensed registered nurses in this state and have previously achieved the passing score on the licensing examination required by this state at the time of graduation. Military-trained applicants, military spouses, or persons establishing residence are subject to Sections 73-50-1 or 73-50-2.
requirements.quote: if, in the opinion of the board, the applicant meets the qualifications required of licensed registered nurses in this state and has previously achieved the passing score or scores on the licensing examination required by this state, at the time of his or her graduation

national_certification.value: National Certification Organization (board-approved certifying body for APRN)
national_certification.quote: Certification by a board-approved certifying body. Such certification shall be required for initial state certification and any recertification as a registered nurse anesthetist, nurse practitioner or nurse midwife.

national_association.value: National Association of Long-Term Care Administrator Board (NAB)
national_association.quote: completed a nursing home Administrator-in-Training Program and successfully completed the National Association of Long-Term Care Administrator Board (NAB) examination

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not licensed or holding the privilege to practice under the provisions of this article: (a) To practice or offer to practice as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse

credential_type.quote: A "license" means an authorization to practice nursing as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse designated herein.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not licensed or holding the privilege to practice under the provisions of this article: (a) To practice or offer to practice as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume such title or use such abbreviation, or any words, letters, signs or devices to indicate that the person using the same is a registered nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud or deceit in securing or attempting to secure the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed fraud or deceit in securing or attempting to secure such license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony, or a crime involving moral turpitude or has had accepted by a court a plea of nolo contendere to a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligently or willfully acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has negligently or willfully acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of the persons under the licensee's care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license or privilege to practice suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license or privilege to practice as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligently or willfully practiced nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has negligently or willfully practiced nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards of such nursing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligently or willfully violated any order, rule or regulation of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has negligently or willfully violated any order, rule or regulation of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsified or repeatedly negligently made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a repeatedly negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to or dependent on alcohol or other habit-forming drugs or misappropriated medication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to or dependent on alcohol or other habit-forming drugs or is a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effect, or has misappropriated any medication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has a physical, mental or emotional condition that renders the licensee unable to perform nursing services with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a physical, mental or emotional condition that renders the licensee unable to perform nursing services or duties with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct constituting a crime under Title 97 that relates to employment as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any other conduct, whether of the same or of a different character from that specified in this article, that would constitute a crime as defined in Title 97 of the Mississippi Code of 1972

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in any unprofessional conduct as identified by the board in its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in any unprofessional conduct as identified by the board in its rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of this article
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of provisions relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners (repealed effective 7/1/2025)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners. This paragraph shall stand repealed on July 1, 2025

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of nursing' by a registered nurse means the performance for compensation of services which requires substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological and sociological sciences and of nursing theory as the basis for assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation in the promotion and maintenance of health; management of individuals' responses to illness, injury or infirmity; the restoration of optimum function; or the achievement of a dignified death.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of nursing" by a registered nurse means the performance for compensation of services which requires substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological and sociological sciences and of nursing theory as the basis for assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation in the promotion and maintenance of health; management of individuals' responses to illness, injury or infirmity; the restoration of optimum function; or the achievement of a dignified death.

value: execution of the medical regimen including administration of medications and treatments
methods_authorized.quote: "Nursing practice" includes, but is not limited to, administration, teaching, counseling, delegation and supervision of nursing, and execution of the medical regimen, including the administration of medications and treatments prescribed by any licensed or legally authorized physician or dentist.

drug_authority.value: RNs and LPNs may administer medications prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist. APRNs (CNMs and CNPs) may prescribe Schedules II-V controlled substances after completing a board-approved educational program and receiving prescription authority from the board. APRNs must practice within a board-approved protocol/practice guidelines in a collaborative/consultative relationship with a physician or dentist.
drug_authority.quote: Certified nurse midwives and certified nurse practitioners may apply for controlled substance prescriptive authority after completing a board-approved educational program. Certified nurse midwives and certified nurse practitioners who have completed the program and received prescription authority from the board may prescribe Schedules II-V.

license_tiers.quote: An "advanced practice registered nurse" is a person who is licensed or holds the privilege to practice under this article and who is certified in advanced practice registered nurse or specialized nursing practice and includes certified registered nurse midwives, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified nurse practitioners.

aprn_role_categories.quote: includes certified registered nurse midwives, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified nurse practitioners

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: These services are performed under the direction of a registered nurse or a licensed physician or licensed dentist

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall perform those functions authorized in this section within a collaborative/consultative relationship with a dentist or physician with an unrestricted license to practice dentistry or medicine in this state and within an established protocol or practice guidelines, as appropriate, that is filed with the board upon license application, license renewal, after entering into a new collaborative/consultative relationship or making changes to the protocol or practice guidelines or practice site.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: The advanced practice registered nurse may not practice as an APRN if there is no collaborative/consultative relationship with a physician or dentist and a board-approved protocol or practice guidelines.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Certified nurse midwives and certified nurse practitioners may apply for controlled substance prescriptive authority after completing a board-approved educational program. Certified nurse midwives and certified nurse practitioners who have completed the program and received prescription authority from the board may prescribe Schedules II-V.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board may establish by rule an alternative to discipline program for licensees who have an impairment as a result of substance abuse or a mental health condition

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: In a collaborative/consultative relationship with a licensed physician whose practice is compatible with that of the nurse practitioner. Certified registered nurse anesthetists may collaborate/consult with licensed dentists. The advanced practice nurse must be able to communicate reliably with a collaborating/consulting physician or dentist while practicing.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: advanced nursing must be performed within the framework of a standing protocol or practice guidelines, as appropriate
